verdict.rationale: Supabase's CLI docs explicitly describe headless setup ('supabase init' + 'supabase start') and state the CLI can run the whole stack 'locally, on your machine or in a CI environment,' which supports scripted automation of backend provisioning. RLS policy examples (auth.uid()-based policies) and built-in Auth methods show schema/auth/policy configuration is all expressible via SQL/CLI artifacts that a script or agent could apply. Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end example or reference of an AI agent scripting the full init→migrate→policy→auth flow autonomously, and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow (evidence instead shows agents interacting via MCP, a separate interactive path, not scripted CLI provisioning).
